Ethnic Voices Tanzania: A Multilingual Speech and Text Dataset for Six Tanzanian Ethnic Languages
	


	
		
	
	
		Tanzanian Ethnic Voices (EVOC) Speech Dataset
	


	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

The Tanzanian Ethnic Voices (EVOC) Speech Dataset is a multilingual
speech resource designed to support research and technology for
underrepresented Tanzanian languages: Sukuma, Hehe, Zinza, Runyambo,
Subi, and Luguru.
